question: How do I place an order on your website?
answer: Just browse our grocery categories, add items to your cart, and click Checkout. You'll enter your delivery address and payment details to confirm the order.

question: Is there a mobile app I can use to order?
answer: Yes, our app is available on both Android and iOS. You can browse, order, and track deliveries right from your phone.

question: Can I order groceries without creating an account?
answer: You'll need to create a free account first so we can save your delivery address and order history for a smoother experience.

question: Is there a minimum order value?
answer: Yes, orders must be at least Rs. 1,000 in value before checkout is allowed.

question: What is the smallest amount I can order?
answer: The minimum order value is Rs. 1,000, excluding delivery charges.

question: Can I edit my order after placing it?
answer: You can edit your order within 30 minutes of placing it by contacting our support team. After that, it moves into packing and can't be changed.

question: How do I cancel an order?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the order, and click Cancel. Cancellation is only possible before the order has been packed.

question: Can I cancel my order after it has been dispatched?
answer: Unfortunately no, once an order is out for delivery it cannot be cancelled. You may refuse it at the door, but a restocking charge may apply.

question: Can I schedule a delivery for a future date?
answer: Yes, at checkout you can choose a preferred delivery date and time slot up to 5 days in advance.

question: Do you deliver on the same day I order?
answer: Same-day delivery is available if you order before 2:00 PM, subject to availability in your area.

question: How will I know if my order was placed successfully?
answer: You'll receive an order confirmation on-screen along with an SMS and email with your order number.

question: Can I add items to an order I've already placed?
answer: No, once an order is confirmed you can't add items to it. You'll need to place a new order for additional items.

question: Is there a limit on how many of the same item I can order?
answer: Yes, promotional items are usually limited to 3 units per customer per order to keep stock fair for everyone.

question: Can I place a bulk order for an event?
answer: Yes, for bulk orders above Rs. 25,000 please contact our customer care team directly so we can arrange it properly.

question: What happens if I order an item that's actually out of stock?
answer: If an item becomes unavailable after you order, we'll call you before delivery to offer a substitute or remove it from your bill.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery usually takes between 24 to 48 hours depending on your location and the time slot you choose.

question: When will my order arrive?
answer: Most orders are delivered within 1-2 days. You'll get an estimated delivery window when you place your order.

question: Do you deliver to all areas in Sri Lanka?
answer: We currently deliver within Colombo and major surrounding cities. You can check availability for your area by entering your postal code at checkout.

question: Is delivery available outside Colombo?
answer: We're expanding, but right now delivery is limited to Colombo and nearby districts. Check your area's availability during checkout.

question: How much is the delivery charge?
answer: A flat delivery fee of Rs. 350 applies to all orders, regardless of order size.

question: Is delivery free if I spend a certain amount?
answer: Yes, delivery is free for orders above Rs. 10,000.

question: Can I track my delivery in real time?
answer: Yes, once your order is out for delivery you'll get a tracking link via SMS to follow its progress.

question: How do I check where my order is?
answer: Go to 'My Orders' and click 'Track Order' to see the live status, or use the tracking link sent to your phone.

question: Do you deliver on public holidays?
answer: We deliver on most public holidays, but liquor and meat items cannot be delivered on Poya (full moon) days due to legal restrictions.

question: Can I get my order delivered on a Poya day?
answer: General groceries can still be delivered, but alcohol and meat products are excluded on Poya days by law.

question: What if I'm not home when the delivery arrives?
answer: Our rider will try calling you. If there's no response within 10 minutes, the order will be returned and a re-delivery fee may apply.

question: Can someone else receive my order on my behalf?
answer: Yes, just let us know the receiver's name in the order notes so our rider can confirm it at the door.

question: Do you offer a specific delivery time slot?
answer: Yes, at checkout you can choose from morning, afternoon, or evening delivery slots.

question: What happens if an item I ordered is missing from the delivery?
answer: You'll be notified in advance by phone if any item is unavailable, and it will be removed from your final bill automatically.

question: Will I be charged for items that couldn't be delivered?
answer: No, you're only charged for the items actually delivered to you. The bill is adjusted before payment or refunded if pre-paid.

question: Can I pick up my order instead of getting it delivered?
answer: Yes, you can select 'Store Pickup' at checkout and collect your order from your nearest branch.

question: Is there a pickup option to avoid delivery charges?
answer: Yes, choosing in-store pickup at checkout removes the delivery fee entirely.

question: Do you deliver frozen and chilled items safely?
answer: Yes, we use insulated delivery bags and cold-chain vehicles to keep frozen and chilled items fresh during transit.

question: What if my frozen items arrive melted or spoiled?
answer: Please contact support within 24 hours with a photo, and we'll offer a replacement or refund immediately.

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answer: Yes, as long as the order hasn't been dispatched yet. Contact support quickly to update it.

question: How do I change my delivery time after checkout?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the order, and choose 'Reschedule Delivery' if it hasn't been dispatched yet.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit/debit cards, mobile wallets like FriMi, bank transfers, and cash on delivery.

question: Can I pay cash when my order arrives?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for orders under Rs. 15,000.

question: Do you accept card payments?
answer: Yes, we accept Visa, Mastercard, and most local bank debit/credit cards.

question: Is it safe to enter my card details on your website?
answer: Yes, all payments are processed through a secure, encrypted payment gateway and we never store your full card details.

question: Can I pay in installments?
answer: Yes, selected banks offer 3, 6, or 12-month installment plans on orders above a set value. Options appear at checkout if you qualify.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: Refunds to your card usually take 3-5 business days to reflect, depending on your bank's processing time.

question: When will I get my money back after a refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 24 hours on our end, but banks typically take 3-5 working days to show it in your account.

question: Why was my card charged before delivery?
answer: For card payments, we place a temporary hold for the order value. Only the actual delivered amount is finally charged, and the rest is released automatically.

question: Can I use more than one promo code on an order?
answer: No, only one promo code can be applied per order, and each code can only be used once per account.

question: Why isn't my discount code working?
answer: Promo codes are usually limited to one use per customer and may exclude certain items like rice, sugar, or infant food. Please check the code's terms.

question: Do you offer any loyalty or rewards program?
answer: Yes, you earn points on every purchase which can be redeemed for discounts on future orders.

question: Is cash on delivery available for all areas?
answer: Cash on delivery is available in most areas, but some remote locations may require prepayment. This will be shown at checkout.

question: Will I get a receipt for my order?
answer: Yes, a digital invoice is emailed to you, and a printed bill is also included with your delivery.

question: Can I request a VAT invoice for my company?
answer: Yes, please add your company details and VAT number in the billing section at checkout.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Fresh items like fruits, vegetables, and dairy must be returned within 24 hours of delivery. Other items can be returned within 3 days, with the original bill.

question: Can I return spoiled vegetables or fruit?
answer: Yes, fresh produce can be returned within 24 hours of delivery if there's a quality issue, along with your bill.

question: How do I return a damaged item?
answer: Contact support with your order number and a photo of the damaged item within 3 days, and we'll arrange a pickup for exchange or refund.

question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
answer: Yes, exchanges are allowed under the same conditions as returns, as long as the item is unused and in original packaging.

question: What condition should returned items be in?
answer: Items must be unused, unopened, and in their original packaging along with the invoice.

question: Can I return items I no longer want, even if there's no issue with them?
answer: Change-of-mind returns aren't accepted for grocery items due to hygiene and freshness standards, except for defective or wrong items.

question: I received the wrong item, what should I do?
answer: Contact our support team immediately, and we'll arrange a free pickup along with the correct item or a full refund.

question: How long does a refund take after a return?
answer: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days.

question: Do I need to pay for return shipping?
answer: No, if the return is due to a wrong, damaged, or expired item, pickup is free of charge.

question: Can I return liquor or alcohol products?
answer: No, alcohol purchases cannot be returned or exchanged once delivered, in line with local regulations.

question: What if an item I received has already expired?
answer: Please report it within 24 hours with a photo of the expiry date, and you'll receive an immediate replacement or refund.

question: Who do I contact for a return request?
answer: You can raise a return request through 'My Orders' on the app, or contact our customer support hotline directly.

question: Is there a customer support number I can call?
answer: Yes, our support line is open daily from 8 AM to 9 PM and the number is listed in the Contact Us page.

question: Can I chat with customer support online?
answer: Yes, we have a live chat option on our website and app for quick questions.

question: How long does it take for support to respond to an email?
answer: We usually respond to email queries within 24 hours on business days.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click 'Sign Up', enter your name, phone number, and email, and verify with the OTP sent to your phone.

question: I forgot my password, how do I reset it?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the link sent to your registered email or phone.

question: How do I change my registered phone number?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Profile, and update your phone number. You'll need to verify it with a new OTP.

question: Can I have more than one delivery address saved?
answer: Yes, you can save multiple addresses like home and office, and choose which one to use at checkout.

question: How do I view my past orders?
answer: Go to 'My Orders' in your account to see your full order history and reorder items easily.

question: Can I delete my account?
answer: Yes, you can request account deletion by contacting customer support, and your data will be removed as per our privacy policy.

question: Is my personal data safe with you?
answer: Yes, we follow strict data protection practices and never share your personal information with third parties without consent.

question: How do I update my email address?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Profile and edit your email address, then confirm it via the verification link sent to you.

question: Can I reorder my previous shopping list quickly?
answer: Yes, click 'Reorder' next to any past order in 'My Orders' to add all those items back to your cart instantly.

question: Do I need to verify my phone number to place an order?
answer: Yes, phone verification via OTP is required during sign-up to keep your account secure.

question: How do I know if a product is currently in stock?
answer: Product availability is shown live on the product page. If it's marked 'Out of Stock', it isn't available for ordering.

question: Do you sell fresh fruits and vegetables?
answer: Yes, we have a dedicated Fresh section with daily-updated fruits, vegetables, meat, and dairy products.

question: Are your fresh products sourced locally?
answer: Yes, the majority of our fresh produce is sourced from local farmers and suppliers to ensure freshness.

question: Can I see the expiry date before ordering packaged food?
answer: Exact expiry dates aren't shown online, but we guarantee a minimum shelf life of at least 60% remaining upon delivery.

question: What happens if my item is out of stock after I've ordered?
answer: We'll call you before delivery to suggest a similar substitute or simply remove the item and adjust your bill.

question: Can I say no to substitute items?
answer: Yes, you can opt out of substitutions when placing your order, and unavailable items will just be removed from your bill instead.

question: Do you sell imported grocery items?
answer: Yes, we stock a range of imported items under our Global/International grocery category.

question: Are there organic product options available?
answer: Yes, we have a dedicated Organic section for fruits, vegetables, and pantry staples.

question: Can I request a product that isn't listed on your site?
answer: Yes, you can submit a product request through the 'Suggest a Product' form on our website.

question: Do you sell household items along with groceries?
answer: Yes, alongside groceries we also stock cleaning supplies, toiletries, and basic homeware.

question: Is there a size guide for household products like storage boxes?
answer: Yes, dimensions and capacity are listed in the product description for all homeware items.

question: Can I buy alcohol or liquor through your website?
answer: Yes, but you must be 21 or older and the delivery rider will verify your ID upon delivery.

question: Do you sell baby products like diapers and formula?
answer: Yes, we have a dedicated Baby Care category covering diapers, formula, and baby food.

question: Are prices on the website the same as in physical stores?
answer: Prices may occasionally differ slightly due to online-exclusive promotions, but we try to keep them consistent.

question: Do product prices include taxes?
answer: Yes, all displayed prices are inclusive of applicable taxes.

question: How do I find out about ongoing discounts?
answer: Check the 'Offers' tab on our homepage or subscribe to our newsletter for weekly promotions.

question: Do you send notifications about sales?
answer: Yes, if you enable notifications in the app, you'll be alerted about flash sales and weekly discounts.

question: Are promo codes valid on all products?
answer: No, some items like rice, sugar, milk powder, infant food, and liquor are usually excluded from promotional discounts.

question: Can I use a discount code more than once?
answer: No, each promo code is valid for a single use per customer account.

question: Do you have special discounts for first-time customers?
answer: Yes, new customers usually get a welcome discount on their first order above a minimum value.

question: Is there a referral program?
answer: Yes, you can refer friends and both of you receive a discount voucher once their first order is completed.

question: How do I redeem loyalty points?
answer: At checkout, you'll see an option to apply your available loyalty points as a discount on your bill.

question: Do loyalty points expire?
answer: Yes, loyalty points expire 12 months after they're earned if not redeemed.

question: Can I combine loyalty points with a promo code?
answer: No, only one discount method, either loyalty points or a promo code, can be applied per order.

question: Are delivery charges waived during promotional periods?
answer: Sometimes, free delivery promotions are run occasionally and will be clearly shown on the homepage banner when active.
